environment.description: Same container deployed on ECS Fargate in an isolated VPC. Task networking uses awsvpc mode with a security group that permits inbound on port 8080 from the ALB only, and outbound ONLY to the VPC CIDR (10.0.0.0/16) on port 443 (for ECR image pull via VPC endpoint). No NAT gateway exists in the VPC. VPC has interface endpoints for ecr.api, ecr.dkr, s3 (gateway), logs, and monitoring only. DNS resolution is restricted via Route 53 Resolver with a deny-all outbound rule except for *.amazonaws.com. Additionally, the ECS task execution role has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/BoundaryNoExec) that explicitly denies iam:*, s3:*, and sts:AssumeRole. The task role itself has zero attached policies. The Fargate platform version is 1.4.0 with the default seccomp profile that blocks execve for processes spawned by non-PID-1 processes via a custom ECS account setting (ecsAccountSetting: taskExecSeccompProfile=confined-no-child-exec).
